question: For an already-admitted v3 RTH transition, can strictly causal signal age, multihorizon slope velocity, ATR velocity and acceleration, regime phase, and contemporaneous news-pressure delta distinguish an urgent price escape from a patient executable book strongly enough to tune only the existing ladder dwell?
null_hypothesis: The static patient-to-relentless ladder remains preferable; no causal feature cohort delivers stable net execution improvement after spread, commission, missed-fill, and adverse-selection costs.
lineage_constraints: Reuse the shared OPTIMISTIC to MID to AGGRESSIVE to CROSS to bounded RELENTLESS ladder; create no parallel executor.
Do not alter v3 direction, admission, source ownership, sizing, settlement, or risk.
Treat quote touch or trade-through as a fill bound, never as proof of queue position.
Treat news as attribution-only and compare every news-aware patience counterfactual with an otherwise identical TA-only decision.
Do not infer a rule from one session, one direction, a blocked proposal, or an outcome-selected threshold.

frozen_measurements.primary_population: natural admitted v3 RTH position transitions whose complete execution window is present
frozen_measurements.negative_controls: blocked raw turns and flat checkpoints remain descriptive only

fail_closed: No admitted transition means evidence accumulation, not a relaxed population.
Missing, delayed, stale, crossed, one-sided, under-sized, or discontinuous books are unavailable rather than imputed.
The capture cannot select a transport, submit an order, start a profitability clock, or modify the crowned strategy.
Priority Zero live commissioning preempts analysis immediately.
